name: zocialeye-brandscan
description: Collect Zocial Eye Brand Scan Social Metric data through an authenticated local Chrome profile.
long_description: A local-only MCP server for Zocial Eye Brand Scan. It uses a dedicated visible Chrome profile, requires you to sign in yourself, never accepts credentials, and limits CSV writes to the folder selected at installation. Social Metric remains third-party listening and benchmark data, not native social analytics.

allowed_output_root.title: Allowed CSV output folder
allowed_output_root.description: Choose the only folder where this extension may create or update CSV files.

tools.name: zocialeye_auth_status
tools.description: Open/check the dedicated Chrome profile and report whether Brand Scan is ready for a manual login.

tools.name: zocialeye_collect_preview
tools.description: Collect one brand/month/platform selection through Brand Scan and return a non-mutating CSV plan.

tools.name: zocialeye_commit_csv
tools.description: Atomically write only a previously staged preview after target hashes are rechecked.
